34

Weak storage signal
DRAM stores bits as tiny capacitor charges, producing only a small voltage 
difference on long bitlines.
Sensing takes time
The sense amplifier must detect and amplify a very small voltage change 
into a full 0/1 value.
Destructive read
Reading a DRAM cell disturbs its stored charge, so the data must be 
restored after every row activation.
Large dense arrays
DRAM prioritizes capacity and cost per bit, so rows/bitlines are long and 
have higher RC delay.
Solution: Multi-Bank, Multi-Rank DRAM
